svg.title: Board power and four temperatures at 865 samples over 61.0 hours: 22.2 W on the quad image, 15.7 W on the single and 16.1 W on the deep one at the median, with one sample at 34.4 W.
svg.text: What the card drew and how warm it ran
The card's own sensors, read by the stress driver every five minutes and between legs: board power above, and below
four temperature sensors, named as the card names them (FPGA, Int Vcc, PCB Top Front, PCB Top Rear). Shading and
34.4 W: one sample, during resident on the quad image
median board power (W) by what was running when the sample was taken, and how many samples
The image loaded sets the board's power, not the work: on the quad, a sweep slice with tile items running drew 22.5 W at the median against
22.1 W with only host items running and 22.1 W between legs. Only cft-resident's streaming leg, about 4 s a visit, took it to 34.4 W (one
sample of 865). The card's HBM temperature sensor read 0 in 670 of the 865 samples, so it is left out.
